biggest_catch: Very long Election Day shift (6 a.m. to closing) for a flat $300 in most roles.
catches: Election-period only work, not steady employment.
Very long Election Day: 6 a.m. to closing (typically 13-15 hours).
Mandatory training session required before working.
Must be a registered voter in Bernalillo County; hiring begins ~2 months before each election and is based on staffing needs — applying does not guarantee selection.

steps: Be a registered voter in Bernalillo County.
Submit the online poll-worker application on berncoclerk.gov.
Attend the mandatory training session (paid $35-$70 depending on role).
Work Election Day from 6 a.m. to closing ($300-$400 depending on role).
timing: Election-period only; hiring ~2 months before each election; work is by assignment.
